independentReviews.finding: Pure helper falls back to all original IDs when selected candidate path/hash/range coverage fails.
independentReviews.adjudication: Normal worklist evidenceFor already filters candidate path/hash and requires full coverage before interpretation. The review does not establish a model-reachable cross-file primary-evidence exploit. Defensive helper boundary now returns no cover and withholds local task when primary/callsite coverage is absent; one red/green test covers path, hash, range and parent-callsite mismatch without changing raw evidence.

independentReviews.finding: Two decisive location items keep their order; Node/tsx cannot execute Bun import.meta.dir.
independentReviews.adjudication: With at most two decisive items both fit the two slots, so unchanged order does not starve either and requires no mutation. More than two items rotate. This repository replay is explicitly a Bun command; main reran it under Bun successfully after the boundary fix. Static metadata and byte accounting review agrees with scope; no Node portability claim.

implementation.focusedSlots: First preferred opportunity; next preferred opportunity rotates a different ready question.
implementation.sourceSelection: Whole original path/hash/range/text windows, greedy indexed-range cover; no slicing or semantic compression.
implementation.sourceAllowance: Nonnegative floor of remaining cumulative display bytes divided by remaining dispatches; native subtracts existing actual message/tool window display.
implementation.notShown: Deferred tasks are not offered; catalog retains identities; not-yet-shown reads remain eligible for later display.
implementation.candidateRefinement: Explicit same-question selection among original indexed alternatives; no host choice or extra call.
